confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate for July 2026, not checked against live listings. Assumes roughly 150 JPY per USD. Restaurant and café anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which varies with summer demand and has limited local data. The FX observation comes from a search summary of the RBA exchange-rates page for 15 October 2026; I did not open the RBA page myself.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on general knowledge of mid-sized Japanese prefectural capitals with modest tourist volume and a Sea of Japan coastal setting, scaled to Tottori's lower price level relative to large Japanese cities. Beer, coffee, and cocktail prices are set relative to the restaurant and bar pricing typical of such cities. No specific listings were consulted.
